title: Delegated Codex worker on Windows cannot start its shell: pwsh.exe via the WindowsApps alias fails in a new Engram worktree
outcome: A TermAl-delegated worker on Windows can run its first local shell commands in a newly created worktree, or fails with the native error text reported back to its parent.
acceptance: The cause is identified with evidence: the native error from a reproduced child launch is recorded on this item.

A delegated worker on Windows whose default shell is the WindowsApps pwsh alias can run a read-only command in a new worktree, or the delegation fails before work starts with a named reason that includes the native error, by a test or recorded reproduction.
Any shell-path change is made inside TermAl and changes no user or global configuration.
